purpose: Teach: 奴ら/巷/傍ら/導き/綴っ/無けれ/しかり/情景

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、後輩を「奴ら」呼ばわりするなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't call the juniors 'those guys' like that.
lines.style: Sharp, direct correction. Quick attack on his name. Annoyed but not unkind — the tone of someone calling out a friend for being careless. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、巷の流行を追ってるな、桜
lines.en: You're following trends lately, huh, Sakura?
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Soft deflection — turning it back on her without heat. Curious lilt at the end, inviting her to deny it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ノートの傍らに落書きしてたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you doodling all over the margins of your notebook.
lines.style: Wry, catching-you-in-something-small tone. Accusatory but playful. Slow pace on the middle — drawing out the 'caught you' feeling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先輩の導きで進路決めたな、桜
lines.en: You picked your future path based on what a senior told you to do, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle counter-attack. Not accusatory — more like he's offering her a mirror. Steady delivery, patient, inviting her to think about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ブログに長文綴ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you've been writing these long posts on your blog.
lines.style: Caught-you tone, but softer. Not quite a gotcha — more noticing something real. Slight smile underneath. Doesn't push it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お小遣いが無ければ困るな、桜
lines.en: You'd be in real trouble without your allowance, wouldn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, even delivery. A small smile in the voice. Turning her own logic back at her without malice. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のテスト結果もしかり、まあまあだったな
lines.en: Riku, your test scores were pretty average too, by the way.
lines.style: Casual, almost offhand. The sound of someone evening the score without making a big deal of it. Light, unburdened pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭の情景を絵に描いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were painting the scenes from the cultural festival, weren't you?
lines.style: Genuine warmth underneath. Noticing something he cares about — not teasing now, but seeing him. Slower pace on 'painting'. Soft, almost fond.
